question: Two circular loops of radius $r$ and $2r$ carry currents $I$ and $I/2$ respectively. They are placed concentrically in the same plane. Analyze the net magnetic field at the center and the magnetic potential energy of the interaction if the outer loop is rotated by $90^\circ$ about a diameter.

options.A: Initial B is non-zero; Interaction Energy becomes zero.
options.B: Initial B is zero; Interaction Energy is Max.
options.C: Initial B is non-zero; Interaction Energy is unchanged.
options.D: Initial B is zero; Interaction Energy becomes zero.
